appearance: Use the approved full-app Alden: slim, soft narrow face, thoughtful gentle expression, modest brown hair, charcoal hoodie over a light gray shirt. Avoid broad shoulders, a strong jaw, glamorous features, and exaggerated hair volume.
framing: Consistent head and shoulders at exactly 32 by 32 pixels; transparent background; four visible colors shared across all frames, drawn from Pebble's 64-color RGB grid.
playback: Between sentences only. Play a short finite sequence, then hold the final frame with no timer until a fresh Select advances. Never loop while reading or automatically return to idle.
reviewGate: Review all six Alden reactions at native size and integer enlargement before generating other characters or replacing reader portraits.
status: Earlier pilot superseded by user-approved Chibi style; retained for provenance only.
